title: Storage architecture: graph+relational + vector retrieval are complementary not alternatives
summary: SQLite/Postgres stores the bi-temporal graph (task nodes, edges, validity windows, supersede chains) — relational semantics required for temporal queries. MiniLM vector embeddings sit on top for semantic retrieval. A pure vector DB cannot express supersede chains or as-of queries. Positioning must clarify: storage layer is graph/relational, retrieval layer is vector.
